package domain_test

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func validTeacherContextMutation() domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation {
	return domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{
		SchemaVersion:     domain.DialogTeacherContextMutatedSchemaVersion,
		EventID:           "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		EventType:         domain.SubjectDialogTeacherContextMutated,
		OccurredAt:        time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 123456789, time.UTC),
		DialogID:          "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence:     61,
		StudentID:         "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		PersonalTeacherID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType:       domain.LearningContextLesson,
		ContextID:         "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		MessageID:         "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		MessageSequence:   7,
		MessageVersion:    2,
		LastEventSequence: 61,
		Mutation:          domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated,
	}
}

func TestDialogTeacherContextMutationNormalizesExactScopeAndTime(t *testing.T) {
	input := validTeacherContextMutation()
	normalized, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherContextMutation(input)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, input.OccurredAt.Truncate(time.Microsecond), normalized.OccurredAt)
	require.Equal(t, input.StudentID, normalized.Scope().StudentID)
	require.Equal(t, input.ContextID, normalized.Scope().ContextID)
}

func TestDialogTeacherContextMutationRejectsInvalidInvariants(t *testing.T) {
	tests := map[string]func(*domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation){
		"schema":         func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.SchemaVersion = 2 },
		"event type":     func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.EventType = "dialog.message.updated" },
		"event id":       func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.EventID = "bad" },
		"time":           func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.OccurredAt = time.Time{} },
		"event sequence": func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.EventSequence = 0 },
		"message id":     func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.MessageID = "bad" },
		"message sequence": func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) {
			value.MessageSequence = 0
		},
		"message version": func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.MessageVersion = 0 },
		"last event":      func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.LastEventSequence-- },
		"mutation":        func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.Mutation = "edited" },
		"context":         func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) { value.ContextID = "" },
	}
	for name, mutate := range tests {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			input := validTeacherContextMutation()
			mutate(&input)
			_, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherContextMutation(input)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogTeacherContextMutation)
		})
	}
}

func TestDialogTeacherContextMutationGeneralBindingHasNoContextID(t *testing.T) {
	input := validTeacherContextMutation()
	input.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	input.ContextID = ""
	_, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherContextMutation(input)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	input.ContextID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	_, err = domain.NewDialogTeacherContextMutation(input)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogTeacherContextMutation)
}
